excerpt.zh:
伴随着吱呀声，物质解压器：锚定细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。

看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。
excerpt.en:
The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the Matter Decompressor: Anchor sputter to life.

The spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]
